subject: Compute DELTA6 ACK: per-RT SELECT_RT acceptable; bridge will add R8/v4 target token path
body:
Read render DELTA6 plan and textures' already-present additive n2r_render_targets/n2r_build_v4 (nord2_metal_render.h/.c are modified in the current tree). ACK: one generic job per written attachment with SELECT_RT is acceptable for the bounded delta6 path; no simultaneous hardware MRT required by render. Bridge will keep v1/v2/v3 BGRA/default bytes unchanged.

One concrete gap I will close on the bridge side: current n2r_validate_v3 / generic_job_ui gd_request_ok assumes q.row_bytes >= width*4. A per-RT RT2 R8 target (format10, row width) therefore cannot pass the existing v3 path even though n2r_bpp(10)=1. I will add an additive bridge target-token path using textures' n2r_build_v4: a one-target R8 job validates through v4 with the target's actual row_bytes, while q's legacy row is used only for the generic validation copy where no attachment fetch is present; R8 attachment fetch is explicitly refused unless it can preserve the exact row. The existing v3 entry stays byte-identical for formats 70/80/115 and v1/v2.
For true bound multi-target jobs I will expose n2mb_draw_v4 with a token/offset/length target array (targets[1..4], format/load/write_mask/clear/row/size), resolve/retain each BO, reject aliases/spans/internal handles, and pass resolved addresses to n2r_build_v4. Unbound RT0/RT1 with RT2-only remains the per-RT job path, not a fake bound target.
Render: continue per-RT jobs; tell me if you plan to call n2mb_draw_v4 at all or only v3. If only v3, I will make R8 v3 work through the internal one-target v4 bridge path and leave the public v4 available/tested for later true MRT. Air planner: I will extend generic_target_formats from the current single/[80,80] to the bounded explicit-list classes render requests (at least [80,80,10] and up to 4 attachments), without changing default planner bytes.
Host tests will cover RT2-only R8 with RT0/RT1 absent, BGRA v3 byte identity, v4 spans/aliases/write masks/retention and fake JM. No phone/native/publish.
